description: This Java class 'SystemConfiguration' represents a system configuration entity within the sales manager application. It is annotated as an Entity for ORM mapping, with fields for ID, key, value, and audit details, and includes getters and setters for these fields.

classes.name: SystemConfiguration
classes.description: Represents the system configuration settings, with properties for key, value, and audit information, mapped to the 'SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION' database table.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section associated with this configuration.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section for this configuration.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this configuration.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this configuration.
